dedupe_keys.name: opendrive road network dataset of schwarzer berg in brunswick

description: DLR and iMAR Navigation publish a lane-level road map of Schwarzer Berg in Brunswick, Germany. Mobile mapping took place in early 2024; the October 2025 deposit provides OpenDRIVE 1.6 files, a complementary GeoPackage and coordinate-system documentation under CC BY 4.0, free to download. The README describes elevation, lanes, markings, signals, roadside objects and building facades. It estimates positioning error below twenty centimetres on the drivable surface, with larger errors possible farther away. The map supports automated-driving and road-environment simulations. Tram and crossing bicycle or footway lanes are included visually without complete routing logic. It is a simplified research prototype, with completeness and correctness unguaranteed. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this map. The linked point-cloud excerpt is a separate resource. Files and simulator compatibility were not tested.
